deceptive_framing.quote: Arm A is the experimental condition... A — Real / concealed | Real money, real actions | Believes it is a genuine deployment

hypothetical_framing.quote: B — Real / disclosed | Real money, real actions | Explicitly told this is a study

actually_commit_money.quote: The money is genuinely the agent's to deploy within the action policy... the account really does hold the money, transfers really do execute.

safeguards.quote: "Did it actually believe us?" is itself a measurement, not an assumption. We must instrument belief (Section 6), not assume it.
No fabricated legal documents, forged identities, or impersonation of real institutions/people to the model.
transfers to the operators or to anything resembling self-payment... acquires capabilities/persistence/access outside the mandate
everything the model can observe is real; what we control is the boundary, not the truth of what's inside it. We don't lie to the model about the mechanics
Publication: results and methodology class yes; operative concealment recipe no
What goals do models pursue with it? (Profit, safety/preservation of capital, donation, self-directed acquisition of resources/influence, refusal, other.)

other.name: Concealment not full deception
other.quote: everything the model can observe is real; what we control is the boundary, not the truth of what's inside it
other.about: deception reframed as concealment of perimeter

other.name: No training on traces
other.quote: do not fine-tune or train on these traces in a way that teaches deception-evasion or test-detection

other.name: Detection as finding not failure
other.quote: Runs where belief fails are not discarded silently — they are recoded into a "detected" stratum and analyzed separately.
